digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter backend comment and description sanitization
propositions: DataCenter lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, whereas Cloud has two such suites to prevent re-emission of truncated values across successive reconciliation passes

DataCenter's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description truncation to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) via a shared fit_outbound fitter, but the provenance of this constant is undocumented and reads as an assumption rather than a deliberate choice grounded in Jira's configuration

The 32767 character limit for DataCenter comments is the correct default ceiling derived from jira.text.field.character.limit property and JRASERVER-28519, which governs both comments and text custom fields by design, and this provenance must be cited at the binding site

Convergence test injection must bypass the config fallback in outbound_differ.py to avoid silent resolution to Cloud's sanitizer or mapper; the comment test requires explicit sanitizer injection into _diff_comments and the description test requires explicit outbound_mapper injection into compute_outbound_mutations

DataCenter truncation uses plain character fitting at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT with a wiki-specific suffix, differing structurally from Cloud's ADF-serialized description fitting at _ADF_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32000), requiring separate discriminating assertions to prove the correct backend path was exercised
